text: The ___ Mapping Theorem asserts that any simply connected proper subdomain of the complex plane is conformally equivalent to the open unit disk.
explanation: The Riemann Mapping Theorem guarantees a biholomorphic (conformal) bijection from any simply connected proper open subset of C onto the unit disk. It is a pure existence result; the map is usually not explicit, though Schwarz-Christoffel handles polygonal domains.
